name: Assamite Sorcery (Awakening of the Steel) — 2 Intermediate — Pierce Steel's Skin

system.description: You command your blade with such precision it strikes at an opponent's armor rather than his body, shredding even the strongest metal and leaving him exposed for the next attack. For this turn and the next three turns, any successful attack you make with the weapon destroys two health levels' worth of armor protection for every one health level you would normally inflict, rather than damaging the wearer, until the armor (which must be metal) is completely destroyed. While active, an attack against an unarmored target only inflicts half damage (rounded down). At the Storyteller's discretion, you may cut through other inanimate objects (walls, doors, cars) without damage to the sword. Fortitude counts as part of the target's own defense, not external armor, for purposes of this power. You must have a total number of Ability Traits in Melee and Crafts: Blacksmith equal to your level of mastery in this path.
